name: Kanban
description: Simple general-purpose board for continuous flow work.

columns.name: todo
columns.label: To Do
columns.description: Work that has not started yet.
columns.hint: Move here when a task is defined and ready to be picked up.

columns.name: in_progress
columns.label: In Progress
columns.description: Work actively being done right now.
columns.hint: Move here as soon as you begin working on the task.

columns.name: done
columns.label: Done
columns.hint: Move here only when the task is fully complete and verified.
